decisions.reason: The operator line has its own website page and complements the core garage door range, so it likely meets aspirations, and the firm has the slack to keep developing it.

The solid wood sectional door is a niche variant that is only mentioned on the website, but it adds to the one-source range at little cost, so there is no performance shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of the resources.
The remote-control operator fits the growing demand for comfortable garage access and supports door sales, so the firm keeps it despite its low visibility.
This glazed industrial sectional door overlaps with Product F, which raises some risk of consolidation, but it is a standard part of the industrial portfolio and is likely kept for now.
The insulated glazed variant answers German energy-efficiency requirements, giving it a clear market role that justifies keeping it.
Its dedicated website page signals that management treats it as a lead industrial door, so it likely performs at or above aspiration.
